_note: REFERENCE suite — hand-authored, NOT a @metaharness/darwin-generated bench.json. `darwin bench create .` stamps a taskHash and `darwin bench verify` REJECTS any hand-edited suite as tampered (grounded: agent-harness-generator / rupixel/docs/BENCH.md). This file documents radio-moe's evolvable surface, objectives, baseline, and score command so a real suite can be generated and reviewed against it. See docs/METAHARNESS.md.
name: radio-moe-independence
freeze: Source code + algorithm are FROZEN. Only the evolveParameters below change. Signature/replay/sequence checks, fail-closed semantics, and the hard gates are constitutional constants (mesh-evolve.ts HARD) that evolution can never touch.

sameAccuracyBand.note: EXCLUDED from in-repo flywheel mutation until the accuracy-band axis gets its own bench (ADR-397 research §Update).

score.note: Decision-quality floor at the current weights. Parameter-SENSITIVITY (how weights move the correlated/diverse separation) is scored by the in-repo flywheel fitness `evaluate()` in mesh-evolve.ts — see docs/METAHARNESS.md.

objectives.description: lineage-weighted fused accuracy minus best-single on the correlated-error corpus

constraints.name: hard-gates
constraints.must: mesh-evolve.ts hardGatesPass === true (familyStack < 2.0 AND diversePair >= 1.7 AND topicSeparation >= 4 AND stack can never quorum AND diversity still can)

constraints.name: quality-floor
constraints.must: metrics.correlated_gain_vs_best >= 0 (fusion never worse than the strongest single expert on correlated errors)

removability: radio-moe builds, tests, and runs with ZERO @metaharness/darwin dependency. The in-repo flywheel (mesh-evolve.ts, `npm run evolve`) is the self-contained, removable evolver of exactly these parameters (ADR-400). Darwin output would be read-only; nothing in the runtime reads it automatically. `.metaharness/` is dev-only and can be deleted with no runtime impact.
